summary: The DGA select: a token-styled native select for choosing one value of any type from a short list of options. A signal-model control: bind [(value)] or a signal-forms field.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: The chosen option value; null means nothing is chosen. Two-way [(value)].

inputs.name: options
inputs.type: readonly DgaSelectOption<T>[] ({ value: T; label: string; disabled?: boolean })
inputs.description: The choices, with translated labels, in display order.

inputs.name: compareWith
inputs.description: Matches the model to an option; give one when values are recreated objects, for example (a, b) => a.id === b.id.

inputs.name: ariaLabel
inputs.description: Accessible name when the surrounding UI already labels the select (translated).

inputs.name: placeholder
inputs.description: The empty first choice (translated). An empty choice is always shown while nothing is chosen.

inputs.name: hint
inputs.description: Help text under the select (translated), linked by aria-describedby.

inputs.name: error
inputs.description: Error message (translated); a non-empty error marks the select invalid.

inputs.name: required
inputs.description: Native required plus a decorative asterisk; the placeholder cannot be chosen again once a value is set.

inputs.name: invalid
inputs.description: Marks the select invalid without a message (a form field may set it).

outputs.name: valueChange
outputs.description: The chosen value when the user picks an option, null for the empty choice (the model's change event).

outputs.name: touchedChange
outputs.description: Emits true on the first blur.

a11y: A native select, so the browser provides the keyboard model (arrows, type-ahead, Home/End, Alt+Down), the phone picker and screen-reader support in Arabic and English. The label is linked with for/id; hint and error are linked with aria-describedby, and an error or invalid sets aria-invalid. The chevron is decorative and sits at the inline end (left in RTL, right in LTR) through logical CSS.
